svg.aria-label: IPO pricing press: a roadshow drum feeds S-1 paper slips toward a pricing dial whose lit orange needle sits past $78 at $83, inside a lit zone past the $70-$78 range; a lit PRICE lever is thrown to the $83 position; a share-count drum holds the 980 million shares; an opening bell rings over a ticker tape spooling out ANT; a small valuation gauge reads the roughly $1.5 trillion fully diluted valuation. Readout: $83, 980M shares, about $81.34bn raised, about $1.5tn, ANT, Nov 19.
